start.title: Apply to join the PA Compact
start.intro: Your state of qualifying license reviews your application. You'll get an email when it decides.
start.residenceHint: Where you live. It can be in a different state from your license. Legal papers can be sent to you here by mail.
start.stateHint: A state in the compact where you hold a full and unrestricted PA license. If there's more than one, choose any of them.
start.otherNames: Other names you use or have used (optional)

statements.title: Statements and submit
statements.heading: Statements
statements.backgroundCheck: To join the PA Compact, submit to a criminal background check, including fingerprints, through {{state}}'s process within 60 days of applying.
statements.resubmitIntro: You're resubmitting, so agree to the statements and sign again.

received.heading: Application received
received.applied: You applied on {{date}}. {{state}} will review it next.
received.next1: {{state}} checks your license against its records.
received.next2: To join the PA Compact, submit to a criminal background check, including fingerprints, through {{state}}'s process within 60 days of applying.
received.next3: If {{state}} needs more information, PA Compact will email you.
received.next4: If {{state}} confirms you're eligible, PA Compact will email you. Then you can apply for Compact Privileges to practice in other states, and pay their fees.
received.resubmitted: You resubmitted it on {{date}}. {{state}} will review it again.
received.again2: If you haven't yet, submit to a criminal background check through {{state}}'s process within 60 days of your application.

errors.heading: There is a problem
errors.load: We couldn't load your application. Try again later.
errors.save: We couldn't save your answers. Try again.
errors.stateNotLive: That state isn't taking applications. Choose another state.
errors.statementsChanged: A statement changed since you read it. Read the statements again and check each one.
errors.otherNameLastName: Enter a last name for the other name, or leave the other name blank.
errors.withdraw: We couldn't withdraw your application. Try again.

intro.title: Join the PA Compact
intro.step1: Give your license and details, then sign the statements and submit.
intro.step2: Your state of qualifying license checks your license against its records.
intro.step3: To join the PA Compact, submit to a criminal background check, including fingerprints, through that state's process within 60 days of applying.
intro.step4: If that state confirms you're eligible, PA Compact will email you. Then you can apply for Compact Privileges to practice in other states, and pay their fees.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.applicationHeading: Your application to join the PA Compact
dashboard.reviewChecks: {{state}} checks your license. If you haven't yet, submit to a criminal background check through {{state}}'s process within 60 days of your application.
dashboard.reviewEmail: PA Compact will email you when {{state}} decides. Once you're eligible, you can apply for Compact Privileges to practice in other states.
dashboard.withdrawHeading: Withdraw your application to join the PA Compact?
dashboard.withdrawBody: {{state}} will stop reviewing it. To join later, you'll need to apply again.
dashboard.withdrawnAlert: You withdrew your application on {{date}}. PA Compact emailed you and {{state}}.
dashboard.withdrawnText: {{state}} has stopped reviewing it. To join the PA Compact later, apply again.
dashboard.deniedAppeal: {{state}} found you not eligible. You can appeal to {{state}} under its law. To find out how and by when, contact {{state}}.
dashboard.deniedAgain: You can apply again through {{state}} or another state where you hold a license.
dashboard.noPrivileges: You don't have any Compact Privileges yet. A Compact Privilege lets you practice as a PA in another state in the compact, under that state's laws. To get one, you choose the states, meet any requirements they have, and pay their fees.
dashboard.resubmitBy: {{state}} needs more information. Update your application and resubmit it by {{date}}. If {{state}} doesn't have it by then, your application is withdrawn.

history.withdrawn_by_deadline: PA Compact withdrew your application after 60 days.
history.superseded: A new state of qualifying license replaced this application.

update.title: Update your application
update.replyHint: Answer {{state}}'s note here, upload a document, or both.
update.uploadHint: Only if {{state}}'s note asks for one. One file: PDF, Word, PNG or JPEG.
update.anotherState: To apply through another state, withdraw this application and apply again.

fix.statements: Tick the statements to agree to them
fix.statement: Tick the statement to agree to it
fix.understand: Tick the box to confirm you understand
fix.swornName: Type your full name to sign
